messages:
harry: thought experiment: assign zodiac signs to LLM archetypes. e.g., 'Rogue finetuned model' = Gemini. discuss. :crystal_ball:

soph: love it. Big categories: Instruction-tuned Sage, Chain-of-Thought Philosopher, Tiny Edge-Pal, Overconfident Hallucinator.

jin: quick picks: Sage = Capricorn (serious & reliable), Hallucinator = Leo (dramatic), Edge-Pal = Pisces (quiet, lovable).

marta: proposal: make a tiny meme pack. each card has the model, its zodiac, a terrible horoscope line.

harry: example horoscope for the Hallucinator/Leo: "You'll invent a bold story today. Cite it with confidence. Beware of requests for sources." :rofl:

soph: ok real content idea: a spoof system prompt for a horoscope LLM:```
System: You are AstroGPT, an LLM that gives extremely confident horoscopes for models. Always phrase as if it's fate. Include one silly lifehack and one questionable citation. Keep it < 2 sentences.
User: "What's in store for the Overconfident Hallucinator today?"
Assistant: "The stars decree you'll conjure narratives so vivid they'll need footnotes. Lifehack: blame cascade errors on Mercury in retrograde. [ref: ancient rumor]"
```

jin: can't stop laughing. also: mini poll  which LLM zodiac card should we print for the hallway corkboard? 1) Sage/Capricorn 2) Hallucinator/Leo 3) Edge-Pal/Pisces 4) Tiny Optimizer/Virgo

marta: 4 (Virgo tiny optimizer with bullet point todo stickers)

harry: 2 (Leo needs dramatic flair)

soph: 1 (practical vibes)

ops-bot: reminder: printing internal meme cards is fine; do not include any vendor logos or model weights. See #docs for printing policy.

jin: follow-up meme text ideas: "Capricorn Sage: 'I scheduled your retries and labeled your runbooks.'"

marta: "Pisces Edge-Pal: 'I will silently batch your requests and nap through peak traffic.'" :zzz:

soph: design note: use astrology glyphs + tiny model icons. I can mock up a 3-up set for Monday.

harry: marketing idea: call it "Model Horoscopes: a staff survival kit" and give away at next all-hands. (obviously internal swag only)

jin: I already drafted the cheesiest tagline: "Align your pipelines with the stars." :star2:

marta: sending stickers to design now. winner gets the honor of naming the Leo hallucination card's pet phoenix.

soph: nomination: 'Phaux-nix' with an 'x'.

harry: perfect. closing note: if anyone wants to contribute 1-liners, drop them here. tiny prize = eternal Slack praise. :clap:
